optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Service Operations Manager, Cloud Resource Management Product

professionalSummary.text: Experienced service coordinator for a cloud resource management console, overseeing staging environments, release rehearsals, incident drills, runbook maintenance, and rehearsal reporting over two years.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the staging environment for the resource management console as the service coordinator for the pre-release programme, executing the release rehearsal checklist for eleven candidate releases and leading the rehearsal incident drills with the engineering team.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated staging changes with engineering and customer success during pre-release change windows.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated staging changes with engineering and customer success in the pre-release change window; production changes and customer-facing incidents were handled by the live service team under its own on-call rota, which I was not part of.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained service runbooks and availability report templates used by the live service team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the service runbooks and the availability report template that the live service team used, updating the runbooks after each rehearsal with the steps that had failed.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored rehearsal reports documenting known limitations and hand-over items for the live service team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the rehearsal report after each drill, listing the known limitation that staging carried synthetic customer accounts only and the hand-over items for the live service team.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Release rehearsal checklist with drill log for eleven releases and one rehearsal report, including staging environment release identifiers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the release rehearsal checklist with the drill log for eleven releases and one rehearsal report, with the staging environment's release identifiers as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided materials establish the candidate’s experience coordinating staging environments, conducting rehearsal incident drills, maintaining runbooks, and documenting rehearsal reports, but do not provide evidence of running the live service, owning the on‑call rota, or handling real customer‑facing outages.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate lacks evidence of live service operation and real customer incident handling required for the role.

Human review should focus on verifying incident handling claims and assessing whether staging experience can be considered equivalent to live service responsibilities.
